verdict.rationale: Canva publishes developer APIs (Connect, SCIM, Admin) and an OpenAPI description of the Connect APIs for generating client SDKs, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes an interactive API explorer, a 'try it' console, or runnable examples. Probes of common OpenAPI paths also returned 404. A spec meant for code generation is not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.
